subtitle: A private offline workspace for your notes.
releaseNotes: v0.2.0: Fixed the custom window for real — dragging the titlebar, minimize, maximize/restore, close and edge/corner resizing all work now. The root cause was a CommonJS `require()` call inside an ES module bundle that threw and was silently swallowed, plus missing Tauri v2 window permissions. Also new: Fiverr Activity, a fully offline work-tracker with workspaces, projects, start/pause/resume/stop sessions, session notes, daily & weekly summaries and CSV/JSON export. It never connects to Fiverr and never touches your Fiverr account or online status.
